title: Landing of the Granma in Cuba
summary: On 2 December 1956 the yacht Granma, carrying 82 expeditionaries including Fidel Castro, reached the mangroves at Las Coloradas on Cuba's southeastern coast after leaving Tuxpan, Mexico, on 25 November. Batista's forces scattered the group, but survivors regrouped in the Sierra Maestra and became the core of the Rebel Army.

uncertainty.note: Radio Rebelde gives departure 25 November and landing 2 December 1956; CubaPLUS also gives 2 December.
